display.purpose: Hero title and countdown numerals only.

headline.purpose: Subheads, countdown headers, and plated callouts.

title.purpose: Compact support headings and short descriptor lines.

body.purpose: Sparse explanatory copy, capped at readable line lengths.

label.purpose: Machine-stamped metadata, CTA labels, and unit captions.

shadows.name: signal-glow
shadows.purpose: Active countdown edges, focus states, and illuminated rails.

shadows.name: plate-haze
shadows.purpose: Large hero plates that need floor separation without looking like cards.

motion.name: ease-signal
motion.purpose: Default easing for hover, focus, and signal-line transitions.

motion.name: pulse-soft
motion.purpose: Low-amplitude countdown glow pulse. Remove entirely under reduced-motion preferences.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action styling for register or notify CTAs.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 152px; height: 40px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(86,242,244,0.42); background: #56F2F4; color: #050B0D; font-family: JetBrains Mono, monospace; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1), box-shadow 220ms cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1), filter 220ms cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(86,242,244,0.2); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(86,242,244,0.22), 0 0 24px rgba(86,242,244,0.16); filter: brightness(1.03); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(86,242,244,0.28), 0 0 0 1px rgba(86,242,244,0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action styling for low-priority control options.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 148px; height: 40px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #1C4D50; background: rgba(13,23,26,0.92); color: #E8FFFF; font-family: JetBrains Mono, monospace; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1), box-shadow 220ms cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1), border-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); border-color: rgba(86,242,244,0.5); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(86,242,244,0.16), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(86,242,244,0.08); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(86,242,244,0.24), 0 0 0 1px rgba(86,242,244,0.42); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Countdown Cell
components.description: Primary hero module for time units in the countdown cluster.
components.css: .ds-countdown-cell { width: 120px; padding: 18px 16px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(28,77,80,0.9); background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(19,33,38,0.98) 0%, rgba(13,23,26,0.96) 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(232,255,255,0.04), 0 0 0 1px rgba(86,242,244,0.05); position: relative; overflow: hidden; } .ds-countdown-cell::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(86,242,244,0.06) 0%, rgba(86,242,244,0) 38%); pointer-events: none; } .ds-countdown-value { color: #E8FFFF; font-family: Geist, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 5vw, 4rem); font-weight: 600; line-height: 0.92; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-countdown-label { margin-top: 10px; color: #7CB9BD; font-family: JetBrains Mono, monospace; font-size: 0.74rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-countdown-cell:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(86,242,244,0.22), 0 0 24px rgba(86,242,244,0.12); } .ds-countdown-cell:focus-within { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(86,242,244,0.22), 0 0 0 1px rgba(86,242,244,0.36); }

components.name: Title Plate
components.description: Hero lockup plaque for the event title and subtitle.
components.css: .ds-title-plate { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 18px 24px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid rgba(28,77,80,0.95); background: rgba(13,23,26,0.9); box-shadow: 0 18px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.36); position: relative; } .ds-title-plate::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 16px; right: 16px; top: 0; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(86,242,244,0) 0%, rgba(86,242,244,0.6) 50%, rgba(86,242,244,0) 100%); } .ds-title-main { color: #E8FFFF; font-family: Geist, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 4vw, 3.5rem); font-weight: 600; line-height: 0.95; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-title-sub { color: #7CB9BD; font-family: JetBrains Mono, monospace; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.24em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Surface Panel
components.description: Structural panel treatment for any supporting information that must sit near the hero.
components.html:
System Status
Countdown locked. Signal stable. Awaiting launch window.
components.css: .ds-panel-surface { width: 320px; padding: 20px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(28,77,80,0.8); background: rgba(19,33,38,0.94); color: #E8FFFF; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(232,255,255,0.04), 0 18px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.28); } .ds-panel-title { color: #7CB9BD; font-family: JetBrains Mono, monospace; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-panel-body { margin-top: 10px; color: #E8FFFF; font-family: Geist, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.6; max-width: 26ch; }

narrative.overview:
This system should feel like the user has stepped into a sealed countdown chamber moments before activation. The page is mostly darkness, not emptiness but containment. Cyan signal lines, illuminated rails, and plated surfaces slice through that darkness with intent. Every bright element should look functional, as if it belongs to a machine already running behind the wall.

The composition is singular by design. The page is not a multi-section event brochure, and it is not a cheerful landing page with stacked explainer cards. It exists to heighten anticipation around the remaining time. The reference language is cinematic, cold, and engineered. It explicitly rejects anything playful, pastel, generic SaaS, corporate-blue event branding, cheerful campus-fair aesthetics, rounded startup marketing tropes, or lightweight conference visuals.
keyCharacteristics: Monolithic dark atmosphere with controlled cyan illumination.
Uppercase technical typography that reads like a control-room signal.
Thin frame geometry, corner brackets, and plated surfaces instead of soft cards.
Motion used as system feedback, not decoration.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Electric Cyan appears on a minority of the surface, ideally no more than roughly 10 to 12 percent of the viewport. Its rarity is the tension.

rules.name: The Reactor Rule
rules.body: Large surfaces stay in the #050B0D to #132126 range. Do not brighten the page to make it feel safer.

rules.name: The Uplink Rule
rules.body: Display and label text should read like signals, not prose. Favor uppercase, deliberate tracking, and short bursts of language.

rules.name: The Scarcity Rule
rules.body: The more important the type, the fewer the words. If a line can be removed without hurting the countdown, remove it.

rules.name: The No Pillow Shadow Rule
rules.body: If a panel looks like a floating SaaS card, the shadow is wrong. Blur can support atmosphere, but it must never become the primary depth cue.

dos: Do keep the dominant field between #050B0D and #132126, so the page stays cinematic and pressurized.
Do reserve #56F2F4 for the countdown, active rails, and the highest-priority signals.
Do keep corners disciplined, between 4px and 10px, so the UI feels engineered rather than soft.
Do use uppercase display or mono labels for hero messaging, countdown units, and CTA text.
Do preserve strong contrast, clear keyboard focus, and reduced-motion fallbacks for any glow, sweep, or pulse effect.
donts: Don't build a generic SaaS hero with stacked feature cards, soft gradients, or reassuring marketing copy.
Don't drift into corporate-blue event branding.
Don't introduce cheerful campus-fair aesthetics, rounded startup marketing tropes, or lightweight conference visuals.
Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism, or colored border-left accents as shortcuts for visual interest.
